events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972, and celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock n' Roll Star Turns 54
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher, voice of a generation and purveyor of pure rock 'n' roll attitude, is celebrating his 54th birthday today. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine 55 Years On
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine' a better world. The iconic album, featuring his signature song, still resonates today. Which track from 'Imagine' is your personal anthem?

events.title: Apple released the first iPod 25 years ago
events.blurb: The first-generation Apple iPod, a portable media player that revolutionised how we listen to music, was unveiled on October 23, 2001, and became available for purchase on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: The Gadget That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember when 1,000 songs in your pocket sounded like magic? It's been 25 years since Apple introduced the original iPod, changing the music landscape forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, and would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations. What's the Lennon lyric that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedic icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939, and celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: A Legend of Laughter at 87
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is undeniable. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, in the UK.

angles.name: The White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, self-titled masterpiece – better known as 'The White Album'. A double LP packed with diverse sounds. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy with Queen remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965, in the United Kingdom.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant artistic evolution for the band. A true classic! What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary musician and peace activist, was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost a musical giant. John Lennon's message of peace and love endures. Share your memories and favourite songs from his incredible legacy.
